The three pegs now sit in a row in front of the base, which is the side toward the front edge of the plate. I didn't move the base; it still runs from x 115 to 235 and from y 190 to 250.

| Peg | X range | Y range |
|---|---|---|
| peg_a | 115 – 135 | 165 – 185 |
| peg_b | 135 – 160 | 165 – 185 |
| peg_c | 160 – 175 | 165 – 185 |

- **Left edge:** peg_a starts at x 115, the same as the base's left edge.
- **Touching:** a ends where b starts (x 135), and b ends where c starts (x 160), so there are no gaps.
- **Distance from the base:** all three pegs end at y 185, and the base starts at y 190, so the gap is 5 mm.

The printability check reported no problems after each move.
